# Project Phoenix v49.0 — Two Cross-Era Interactive Situations:
#   1. oe_sit_v49_mercs_and_privateers — Legendary Mercenaries & Privateer Networks (520-1836)
#   2. oe_sit_v49_great_persons        — Dynamic Great Persons Court Bidding (520-1836)
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 (is_data_map = yes, named 01_coa.txt map_color, zero top-level image =).
# Generated by gen_v490_mercs_pirates_masters.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v49_mercs_and_privateers = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 520
		current_year <= 1836
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_mp_ended }
		any_country = {
			oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
			num_locations >= 8
		}
	}

	visible = {
		oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			num_of_ports >= 2
			num_locations >= 12
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Golden Age of Free Companies & Corsairs (index >= 92, post-1650)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_mp_end_freebooter_age"
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_end_freebooter_age_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1650
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_mp_network_index }
				var:oe_v49_mp_network_index >= 92
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v49_mp_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_freebooter_golden_age years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Sovereign Admiralty & Standing Army Order (index <= 8, post-1650)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_mp_end_sovereign_order"
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_end_sovereign_order_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1650
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_mp_network_index }
				var:oe_v49_mp_network_index <= 8
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v49_mp_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_sovereign_admiralty_order years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Twilight of the Old Free Companies (1835 safety horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_mp_end_twilight"
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_end_twilight_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1835
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v49_mp_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_sovereign_admiralty_order years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index value = 45 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_mp_participant }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_participant value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_mp_network_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index value = 45 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v49_mp_network_index < 88
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_letters_of_marque
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_caribbean_privateer_armada
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_barbary_corsair_flotilla
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index add = 0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v49_mp_network_index > 12
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_anti_piracy_pact
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_mp_mod_coopted_royal_navy
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index add = -0.2 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_mp_network_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_mp_network_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_network_index value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_mp_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_mp_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:caribbean_region
					region = region:central_america_region
					region = region:mesoamerica_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_caribbean_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:maghreb_region
					region = region:egypt_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_barbary_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:south_german_region
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:france_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_swiss_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
					region = region:scandinavian_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_varangian_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				region = region:carpathia_region
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_black_army_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:ruthenia_region
					region = region:steppes_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_mp_map_cossack_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:caribbean_region
					region = region:central_america_region
					region = region:mesoamerica_region
				}
			}
			value = black
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:maghreb_region
					region = region:egypt_region
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:south_german_region
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:france_region
				}
			}
			value = yellow_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
					region = region:scandinavian_region
				}
			}
			value = purple
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				region = region:carpathia_region
			}
			value = orange
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:ruthenia_region
					region = region:steppes_region
				}
			}
			value = green
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_caribbean"
		color = rgb { 38 38 38 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_barbary"
		color = rgb { 176 46 52 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_swiss"
		color = rgb { 214 176 52 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_varangian"
		color = rgb { 142 54 128 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_black_army"
		color = rgb { 208 112 36 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_mp_legend_cossack"
		color = rgb { 68 144 58 }
	}
}

oe_sit_v49_great_persons = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 520
		current_year <= 1836
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_gp_ended }
		any_country = {
			oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
			num_locations >= 6
		}
	}

	visible = {
		oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			num_locations >= 10
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Universal Republic of Letters & Genius (index >= 95, post-1785)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_gp_end_republic_of_letters"
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_end_republic_of_letters_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1785
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index }
				var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index >= 95
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v49_gp_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 12
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_republic_of_letters years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Immortal Legacy of the Masters (1835 safety horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_gp_end_immortal_legacy"
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_end_immortal_legacy_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1835
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v49_gp_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_republic_of_letters years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 35 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_participant }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_participant value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 35 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index < 90
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_academy_chair
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_grand_salon
						has_country_modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_royal_bidding_patron
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index add = 0.2 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_gp_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_ended value = 2 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
					region = region:maghreb_region
					region = region:egypt_region
					region = region:crescent_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_map_classical_med_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:south_german_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_map_renaissance_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:east_china_region
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:south_china_region
					region = region:korea_region
					region = region:japan_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_map_east_asia_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:great_britain_region
					region = region:france_region
					region = region:north_german_region
					region = region:iberia_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_map_enlightenment_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
					region = region:maghreb_region
					region = region:egypt_region
					region = region:crescent_region
				}
			}
			value = purple
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:south_german_region
				}
			}
			value = yellow_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:east_china_region
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:south_china_region
					region = region:korea_region
					region = region:japan_region
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:great_britain_region
					region = region:france_region
					region = region:north_german_region
					region = region:iberia_region
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_legend_classical_med"
		color = rgb { 142 54 128 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_legend_renaissance"
		color = rgb { 214 176 52 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_legend_east_asia"
		color = rgb { 176 46 52 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_gp_legend_enlightenment"
		color = rgb { 62 126 196 }
